sentences.text:
1 3. The present writ petition has been filed seeking directions to immediately cease the unauthorized and illegal commercial activities being carried out by respondent no.2 from the lower ground floor (basement) and upper ground floor of the property bearing No. 9/1, East Patel Nagar, New Delhi-110008.
4.

Learned counsel appearing for the petitioner submits that the respondent no. 2, i.e., M/S Blinkit Commerce Private Limited, has unlawfully commenced commercial activity of delivery/distribution hub from residential premises on the lower ground floor (basement) and upper ground floor of the property in question.
5. It is submitted that the commercial activity has been going on since April, 2025.

6. It is submitted that the business in question is being operated from the premises without the mandatory license and approvals from the Delhi Fire Service as well as the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India ("FSSAI").
7.
